meta.title: Manga translation workflow
meta.description: End-to-end manga localisation: auto box detection, local OCR (JA/KO/EN), AI translation, source-text erase plus Chinese embedding, and a failure report. Adds a sidebar workbench with per-page or whole-book scope, optional translation/original overlays, forced retranslation, and pre/post-embed checks; ships a desktop box marker and an auto-detection benchmark. Exposes manga_ocr, manga_embed, manga_status, manga_bench, manga_failures, manga_dsh_translate and manga_report.
